mapper.select: select p.id, p.user_id userId, p.name, p.type, p.approval_time approvalTime, p.status, p.patent_number patentNumber, p.certificate_path certificatePath, p.certificate_name certificateName, p.certificate_size certificateSize, p.audit_user_id auditUserId, p.audit_time auditTime, p.audit_remark auditRemark, p.create_time createTime, p.update_time updateTime, p.delete_flag deleteFlag, u.real_name userName, u.employee_id employeeId, u.phone phone, u.department department, u.email email from patent p left join users u on p.user_id = u.id where p.delete_flag = 0 and p.user_id = #{userId} and p.status = #{status} order by p.create_time desc
